biological_interpretation: The evidence supports LRP6, not LRP5 or Kremen1, as the only proximal receptor perturbation in this packet that exposed a beta-catenin-like thalamic Wnt branch.
caveats: Lrp6 target RNA itself did not reach FDR in any cell type; the call is a weak downstream signature.
Kremen1 and Alx4 are primarily negative comparators and cannot by themselves establish receptor divergence.
exact_observed_result: Lrp6 guides produced four FDR genes in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut despite no FDR-confirmed Lrp6 self-depletion; the report links this state to lower Axin2/Lef1 and an Atrnl1/Nsmf/Nrbp2/Chgb FDR core aligned with Ctnnb1 loss and opposed to Apc loss, whereas Lrp5, Kremen1 and Alx4 were inactive or divergent.
